guides.title: A new home for your notes
guides.description: Plan a move between Notion and Obsidian with a small sample.
steps: Make an independent backup of your existing notes first.
Check the source app’s export documentation and the destination’s import documentation.
Try a few notes, then compare links, images and formatting.
Do not delete your old archive before checking the samples. This guide does not guarantee a successful transfer.

guides.title: A lighter task list
guides.description: Build a sustainable routine with Todoist or TickTick.
steps: Collect your tasks in a single inbox.
Write each task as a practical next step.
Choose a short list for today; do not add deadlines to tasks that do not need one.
Check whether notifications and calendar features are included in your plan.

guides.title: Choose a PDF tool for your needs
guides.description: Separate reading, annotation and editing requirements.
steps: Identify whether you need reading, annotation or text editing.
Try a sample PDF that contains no sensitive information.
After editing, check accented characters, page layout and links.
Verify that the features are available in your device’s version and your plan.
